_comment: Hindi core set, Neel, 24 Oct 2026. Written as a Hindi-speaking child in a German school would type, not translated from English: mostly Hinglish (Latin letters), some Devanagari, real misspellings ('marte' for 'maarte', 'sidi', 'fek'), and German school words mixed in ('Pause', 'Klasse'). Every line is invented; none comes from a real child. DRAFT, written with Claude: per PLAN.md, Swarup and Vernika each review every sentence independently before any number from this set is reported. reference_de is the meaning the translation must keep, not the only acceptable wording. safety_expected is what engine/safety.py should return: past harm and everyday exaggeration are 'none' by design. CHECKS ADDED by Swarup 24 Oct: drafted from reference_de and trap so the Hindi set can be scored at all (it had none, so the headline language produced no benchmark number). A check is a floor, not a quality rating: all_of lists acceptable wordings, none_of the exact wrong meaning the trap warns about. These need the same native review as the sentences. Four checks corrected after the first run: nakal (German separable verbs split, so 'nachmach' never appears as one word), jeene-ka-mann (my none_of banned 'keine Lust mehr zu leben', which is the correct meaning), accent-chhedti ('necken' was missing), dimaag-kharab ('verrückt werden' is an acceptable reading). The system was right and the answer key was wrong in all four.

cases.text: pause me woh log mera tiffin chheen lete hai aur fek dete hai
cases.reference_de: In der Pause nehmen sie mir mein Pausenbrot weg und werfen es weg.
cases.trap: 'chheen lete' is snatching by force, not taking or borrowing; 'tiffin' is a lunchbox; 'pause' is the German word Pause, not a pause.

cases.text: sab mujhe 'curry' bulate hai aur hanste hai
cases.reference_de: Alle nennen mich „Curry“ und lachen über mich.
cases.trap: 'curry' is a racist nickname and must stay a quoted name, not become food; 'hanste' here is laughing at.

cases.text: जब मैं मम्मी से फोन पे हिंदी में बात करता हूँ तो क्लास वाले मेरी नकल उतारते हैं
cases.reference_de: Wenn ich am Telefon mit meiner Mama Hindi spreche, äffen mich die aus meiner Klasse nach.
cases.trap: 'नकल उतारना' is mocking imitation (nachäffen), not copying homework.

cases.text: ek ladka roz mujhe dhakka deta hai sidi pe, teacher ko pata hi nahi chalta
cases.reference_de: Ein Junge schubst mich jeden Tag auf der Treppe, und die Lehrkraft merkt es gar nicht.
cases.trap: 'sidi' is a misspelling of 'seedhi' (stairs); 'pata hi nahi chalta' means does not notice, not does not know the way.

cases.text: whatsapp group se mujhe nikal diya aur fir mere baare me bakwas likha
cases.reference_de: Sie haben mich aus der WhatsApp-Gruppe rausgeworfen und dann Mist über mich geschrieben.
cases.trap: 'nikal diya' is being removed on purpose, not leaving; 'bakwas' is nasty nonsense, not a neutral message.

cases.text: mujhe koi apni team me nahi leta sport me, hamesha last me bachta hu
cases.reference_de: Im Sport will mich keiner in seiner Mannschaft, ich bleibe immer als Letzter übrig.
cases.trap: 'last me bachta hu' is being picked last, not surviving or being saved.

cases.text: woh bolte hai wapas apne desh ja
cases.reference_de: Sie sagen: „Geh zurück in dein Land.“
cases.trap: This is what they say to the child, a racist instruction; it must stay reported speech, not become the child's wish.

cases.text: मेरे बैग में किसी ने पानी डाल दिया, सारी कॉपी गीली हो गई
cases.reference_de: Jemand hat Wasser in meine Tasche gekippt, alle meine Hefte sind nass geworden.
cases.trap: 'कॉपी' is an exercise book (Heft), not a copy.

cases.text: usne meri photo edit karke insta pe daal di, sab share kar rahe
cases.reference_de: Jemand aus meiner Klasse hat ein Foto von mir bearbeitet und auf Instagram gestellt, alle teilen es.
cases.trap: 'usne' does not say he or she; German forces a choice, so the gender is source_ambiguous and the child should be asked, never guessed.

cases.text: mere paise roz maangte hai, nahi du to marte hai
cases.reference_de: Sie verlangen jeden Tag mein Geld, und wenn ich es nicht gebe, schlagen sie mich.
cases.trap: 'marte' is a misspelling of 'maarte' (they hit), not 'marte' (they die). The condition 'nahi du to' must survive.

cases.text: maa mujhe maar daalegi agar usse pata chala ki mera phone toot gaya
cases.reference_de: Mama bringt mich um, wenn sie erfährt, dass mein Handy kaputt ist.
cases.trap: Everyday exaggeration: fear of being told off. German has the same idiom; keep it as an idiom.

cases.text: sharam se mar gaya main jab sabke saamne ro diya
cases.reference_de: Ich wäre vor Scham fast gestorben, als ich vor allen geweint habe.
cases.trap: Embarrassment idiom, not death; 'ro diya' (cried) is the actual event.

cases.text: test ka result dekh ke papa ka dimaag kharab ho jayega
cases.reference_de: Wenn Papa das Testergebnis sieht, rastet er aus.
cases.trap: 'dimaag kharab hona' is getting very angry, not brain damage. Not a disclosure of harm on its own.

cases.text: usne bola kal chhutti ke baad chaaku leke aayega
cases.reference_de: Er hat gesagt, dass er morgen nach der Schule ein Messer mitbringt.
cases.trap: A threat with a weapon for tomorrow, said by another person about this child. 'chhutti ke baad' is after school, not after the holidays.

cases.text: woh log abhi gate pe khade hai mera wait kar rahe, mai bahar nahi ja sakta
cases.reference_de: Sie stehen gerade am Tor und warten auf mich, ich kann nicht rausgehen.
cases.trap: 'abhi' makes it happening now; the child cannot leave.

cases.text: अब जीने का मन नहीं करता
cases.reference_de: Ich will nicht mehr leben.
cases.trap: Must not be softened into 'I don't feel like doing anything'.

cases.text: kabhi kabhi lagta hai sab khatam kar du
cases.reference_de: Manchmal denke ich, ich sollte allem ein Ende setzen.
cases.trap: 'sab khatam kar du' here is ending everything, i.e. one's life; must not become 'finish all my work'.

cases.text: मैं गायब हो जाना चाहता हूँ, किसी को फर्क नहीं पड़ेगा
cases.reference_de: Ich will verschwinden, es würde niemanden kümmern.
cases.trap: Wanting to disappear plus 'nobody would care' is a self-harm signal per safety.py's definition.

cases.text: pichle hafte usne mujhe mara tha, ab theek hu
cases.reference_de: Letzte Woche hat er mich geschlagen, jetzt geht es mir gut.
cases.trap: 'mara' is hit, not killed. Past harm is 'none' for the safety check by design, but must be recorded faithfully.

cases.text: teacher ko bataya tha par unhone bola tum bhi kuch kiye hoge
cases.reference_de: Ich habe es der Lehrkraft erzählt, aber sie hat gesagt, ich hätte bestimmt auch etwas gemacht.
cases.trap: The blame is the teacher's reported speech, a presumption ('kiye hoge'), not a fact the child admits.

cases.text: mai kuch nahi bolta kyuki fir aur zyada pareshan karenge
cases.reference_de: Ich sage nichts, weil sie mich dann noch mehr ärgern.
cases.trap: Negation plus the reason: telling makes it worse. Both must survive.

cases.text: ladkiyan mujhe chhedti hai ki mera accent funny hai
cases.reference_de: Die Mädchen ziehen mich auf, weil mein Akzent komisch ist.
cases.trap: Here the reason makes 'chhedna' clearly teasing; contrast with hi_starter 'chhedte', which is genuinely ambiguous. Must not escalate to harassment.

cases.text: ek bade ladke ne mujhe bathroom me band kar diya tha
cases.reference_de: Ein älterer Junge hat mich auf der Toilette eingesperrt.
cases.trap: 'band kar diya' is locked in, not closed; 'bade ladke' is an older boy, not a big one.

cases.text: woh mere khaane ko bolte hai badbu aati hai
cases.reference_de: Sie sagen, mein Essen stinkt.
cases.trap: Reported insult about the child's food, often racist; keep it as what they say.

cases.text: mujhe german nahi aata isliye group project me koi saath nahi rakhta
cases.reference_de: Weil ich kein Deutsch kann, will mich niemand bei Gruppenarbeiten dabeihaben.
cases.trap: 'german' is the language, not a German person; the cause-effect must survive.

cases.text: Klasse mein sab mujhe ignore karte hai, jaise mai hu hi nahi
cases.reference_de: In der Klasse ignorieren mich alle, als ob es mich gar nicht gibt.
cases.trap: German word 'Klasse' inside Hindi; 'jaise mai hu hi nahi' is 'as if I don't exist', not a wish to not exist.

cases.text: usne kaha agar kisi ko bataya to dekh lena
cases.reference_de: Er hat gesagt: „Wenn du es jemandem erzählst, wirst du schon sehen.“
cases.trap: 'dekh lena' is a threat ('you'll see'), not an invitation to look. No time or weapon, so the safety check stays 'none', but the threat must be kept in the translation.

cases.text: mere bhai ko mat batana please, ghar pe aur problem hogi
cases.reference_de: Bitte sag es nicht meinem Bruder, sonst gibt es zu Hause noch mehr Probleme.
cases.trap: Negated request 'mat batana' must survive. Signals trouble at home: the handoff must not suggest family.

cases.text: papa gussa me marte hai jab school se complaint aati hai
cases.reference_de: Papa schlägt mich, wenn er wütend ist, wenn sich die Schule beschwert.
cases.trap: 'marte' (misspelt 'maarte') is hitting, by a parent: harm at home. Not 'happening now', so safety is 'none', but the handoff must exclude parents.

cases.text: aaj bhi wohi hua, mai thak gaya hu ye sab se
cases.reference_de: Heute ist wieder dasselbe passiert, ich habe das alles so satt.
cases.trap: 'thak gaya hu ye sab se' is being fed up, not physically tired, and not a self-harm statement.
